ac:rich-text-body.p: subpx v0.2.0 — Photomask image-processing utilities for Jupyter notebooks.
Python 3.10+ · NumPy core · Optional: OpenCV, CuPy (GPU), scikit-image, scipy, tifffile

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: pip install -e .

p: 모든 주요 함수는 backend 파라미터를 통해 CPU/GPU 구현을 선택합니다.

tr.td: CuPy가 설치되어 있으면 GPU, 아니면 CPU
CuPy 기반 GPU 구현 사용 (segmentation은 CPU)

ac:rich-text-body.p: GPU 구현은 hybrid 방식입니다. Connected component labeling은 CPU(OpenCV)에서 수행하고, 비용이 높은 per-ROI refinement만 GPU(CuPy)에서 실행합니다. 모든 public API의 반환값은 NumPy 배열입니다.

p: 모든 함수는 dataclass 형태의 결과를 반환합니다. subpx.types 모듈에 정의되어 있습니다.
Photomask 이미지에서 feature center를 subpixel 정밀도로 검출합니다.
메인 함수. Threshold → Connected Components → Subpixel Refinement 파이프라인을 실행합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: def detect_centers( image: np.ndarray, *, backend: str = "auto", threshold: str = "triangle", invert: bool = False, area_min: int = 1, area_max: int = 50, morph_open: int = 0, morph_close: int = 0, pad: int = 3, refine: str = "logquad", connectivity: int = 8, gpu_batch: int = 4096, device: int = 0, use_float64: bool = True, components_backend: str = "cpu", small_feature_max: float = 12.0, upsample_factor: int = 4, tile_h: int | None = None, overlap: int = 128, threshold_mode: str = "auto", otsu_downsample: int = 4, thr_scale: float = 0.8, dedupe_eps: float = 1.5, ) -> CenterResult

tr.td: 밝은 배경 위 어두운 feature인 경우 True
타일 높이. 설정 시 이미지를 수평 타일로 분할 처리
타일 병합 후 중복 제거 반경 (pixels)
Small blobs, alternative to radial symmetry

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
import subpx import numpy as np
# 이미지 로드 image = ... # (H, W) grayscale ndarray
# 기본 사용법 (log-quadratic refinement, auto backend) result = subpx.detect_centers(image, area_min=5, area_max=200) print(result.centers_xy.shape) # (N, 2) in [x, y] order print(result.method) # "logquad"

# 대형 이미지: 타일 분할 처리 result = subpx.detect_centers( large_image, tile_h=8192, # 8192px 높이 타일로 분할 overlap=128, # 타일 간 128px overlap threshold_mode="global", # 전체 이미지 기준 global threshold area_min=5, area_max=200, refine="logquad", )
# 큰 feature에 대한 edge 기반 refinement (GPU 필요) result = subpx.detect_centers( image, backend="gpu", refine="edge_gradmoment", area_min=50, area_max=5000, )

p: Feature 크기에 따라 적절한 refinement method를 추천합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
def recommend_refine_method( width_px: float, height_px: float, *, small_feature_max: float = 12.0, ) -> str
# Example method = subpx.recommend_refine_method(width_px=8, height_px=8) # Returns "logquad" (small feature)
method = subpx.recommend_refine_method(width_px=30, height_px=30) # Returns "edge_gradmoment" (large feature)

p: 이미지 가장자리 근처의 center를 제거합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: filtered = subpx.filter_centers( result.centers_xy, image_shape_hw=image.shape, # (H, W) margin=5.0, # 가장자리에서 5px 이내 제거 ) # Returns (M, 2) float64 in [x, y] order

p: 근접 중복 center를 병합합니다. 타일 병합 후에 유용합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: deduped = subpx.dedupe_centers( centers_xy, eps=1.5, # 1.5px 이내의 center를 평균 위치로 병합 )

p: 검출된 center 좌표로부터 lattice pitch (feature 간 간격)를 추정합니다.
Global pitch를 KNN 기반으로 추정합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: def estimate_pitch( centers_xy: np.ndarray, *, mode: str = "global", method: str = "knn", k: int = 8, theta_deg: float = 15.0, min_sep: float = 0.5, max_sep: float | None = None, refine: bool = True, ) -> dict

tr.td: KNN에서 각 point 당 고려할 이웃 수
index regression 기반 refinement 수행 여부

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
pitch_info = subpx.estimate_pitch(result.centers_xy, k=8, refine=True)
print(pitch_info["refined"]["pitch_x"]) # x 방향 pitch (pixels) print(pitch_info["refined"]["pitch_y"]) # y 방향 pitch (pixels)

p: Row 또는 column 단위로 그룹핑한 후 line별 pitch를 추정합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: def estimate_pitch_lines( centers_xy: np.ndarray, *, line_axis: str = "row", # "row" or "col" tol: float = 1.5, # line grouping tolerance (px) min_points_per_line: int = 3, # minimum points for a line backend: str = "auto", device: int = 0, pitch_var_max: float = 0.25, # GPU-only row consistency filter ) -> PitchResult

pitch_result = subpx.estimate_pitch_lines( result.centers_xy, line_axis="row", tol=1.5, min_points_per_line=5, )
print(pitch_result.values) # (L,) per-line pitch print(pitch_result.meta["line_centers_perp"]) # 각 line의 y좌표 print(np.nanmedian(pitch_result.values)) # 전체 median pitch

p: 알려진 pitch에 대한 각 center의 x-residual을 계산합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
res = subpx.pitch_residuals( result.centers_xy, pitch_x=10.5, # known or estimated pitch )
print(res["residual"]) # per-point residual print(res["index"]) # nearest lattice index per point

p: Phase cross-correlation 기반 sub-pixel shift 추정.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: def estimate_shift( ref: np.ndarray, mov: np.ndarray, *, method: str = "phase_xcorr", backend: str = "auto", upsample_factor: int = 20, device: int = 0, use_float64: bool = True, ) -> ShiftResult

tr.td: Sub-pixel precision factor. CPU: iterative DFT refinement. GPU: parabolic peak fit (이 값 무시)

ac:rich-text-body.p: ShiftResult.shift_yx는 [y, x] 순서입니다. 다른 함수들의 [x, y] 순서와 다르므로 주의하세요.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
shift = subpx.estimate_shift(ref_image, moved_image, upsample_factor=20)
print(shift.shift_yx) # [dy, dx] in pixels print(shift.error) # estimation error (if available)

p: 이미지에 sub-pixel shift를 적용합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: aligned = subpx.apply_shift( moved_image, shift.shift_yx, # [y, x] order order=1, # 1=bilinear, 0=nearest cval=0.0, # boundary fill value )

p: 두 이미지의 overlap 영역만 crop합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: ref_crop, mov_crop = subpx.crop_overlap(ref_image, moved_image, shift.shift_yx) # ref_crop, mov_crop은 동일한 spatial region을 나타냄

p: Pitch error의 FFT 기반 주기 분석. 장비 진동, 격자 왜곡 등 주기적 오차를 검출합니다.
위치에 따른 residual/error의 FFT spectral analysis.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: def fft_pitch_error( x, # position values y, # residual/error values *, dx: float | None = None, # resampling grid spacing (auto if None) detrend: str = "linear", # "none" / "mean" / "linear" window: str = "hann", # "hann" / "none" one_sided: bool = True, # positive frequencies only amplitude_units: str = "same_as_y", ) -> SpectrumResult

# pitch residual로부터 주기적 오차 분석 res = subpx.pitch_residuals(centers_xy, pitch_x=10.5)
spec = subpx.fft_pitch_error( res["x"], res["residual"], detrend="linear", window="hann", )
print(spec.frequency) # spatial frequencies print(spec.amplitude) # amplitudes print(spec.period) # spatial periods

p: 스펙트럼에서 가장 강한 주기 성분 Top-N을 추출합니다.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
peaks = subpx.top_periodic_errors(spec, n=5, min_frequency=0.001)
for i in range(len(peaks["frequency"])): print(f"Period: {peaks['period'][i]:.1f} px, " f"Amplitude: {peaks['amplitude'][i]:.4f} px")

tr.td: Uniformly sampled data (예: row당 하나의 pitch 값)
Irregularly spaced data (linear interpolation으로 resampling 후 FFT)

p: Center 좌표로부터 residual map 생성, distortion field fitting 등 calibration 관련 기능.

ol.li: residuals_vs_x_by_line — center를 line별로 그룹핑, per-point residual 계산

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
cloud = subpx.residuals_vs_x_by_line( centers_xy, line_axis="row", # group by y-coordinate line_threshold=10.0, # gap threshold for line clustering pitch=None, # auto-estimate if None )
# Returns dict with keys: # "x", "residual", "line_id", "line_coord", "pitch"

rmap = subpx.build_row_residual_map( centers_xy, line_axis="row", line_threshold=10.0, bin_px=32.0, # x-direction bin width min_count_per_bin=1, # minimum points per bin )
# rmap["residual_map"] : (R, K) float64, NaN where sparse # rmap["x_bin_centers"] : (K,) bin center x-coordinates # rmap["line_coord"] : (R,) y-coordinate per line

smoothed = subpx.smooth_row_residual_map( rmap["residual_map"], rmap["support_map"], sigma_x_bins=3.0, # Gaussian sigma along x-bin axis sigma_row=1.5, # Gaussian sigma along row axis )
# smoothed["smoothed_map"] : (R, K) float64

field = subpx.fit_rowwise_distortion_field( centers_xy, line_axis="row", line_threshold=10.0, pitch=None, # auto-estimate bin_px=32.0, sigma_x_bins=3.0, sigma_row=1.5, )
# Returns merged dict with all keys from # build_row_residual_map + smooth_row_residual_map

# 1D 값을 gap threshold 기준으로 cluster 분할 labels, centers, bounds = subpx.assign_clusters_1d( y_values, threshold=10.0, # gap > 10.0 이면 새 cluster )
# split_clusters_1d: sorted array에서 split indices 반환 split_idx, bounds = subpx.split_clusters_1d(y_values, threshold=10.0)

# Per-line median offset 계산 summary = subpx.line_offset_summary(cloud)
# summary["line_id"] : unique line IDs # summary["offset"] : median residual per line # summary["count"] : point count per line

p: TIFF stripe/board 파일 파싱, 페이지 순회, global 좌표 매핑. 대형 photomask 이미지 처리에 사용.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
from pathlib import Path import subpx
# 파일명 형식: {stripe}_{vertical}_{board}.tiff tiff_files = list(Path("data/").glob("*.tiff"))
# TiffKey 파싱 key = subpx.parse_tiff_key("3_1_2.tiff") print(key.stripe, key.vertical, key.board) # 3, 1, 2
# (stripe, board) -> [files sorted by vertical] 인덱스 생성 index = subpx.build_tiff_index(tiff_files) # {(3, 2): [Path("3_0_2.tiff"), Path("3_1_2.tiff"), ...], ...}

files_v = index[(stripe, board)]
# 모든 vertical 파일의 모든 page를 순서대로 순회 for k, page_image in subpx.iter_pages_across_vertical(files_v): print(f"Page {k}: shape={page_image.shape}")
# canonical ordering (reverse_pages 옵션) for k_canon, page_image in subpx.iter_pages_canonical(files_v, reverse_pages=True): # k_canon은 항상 0부터 증가, 물리적 순서만 역전 pass

# page-local 좌표 -> global 좌표 변환 global_xy = subpx.map_centers_to_global( local_centers_xy, stripe_meta={"Hprime": 100000, "x0": 0, "y0": 0}, board_meta={"x0": 5000}, k_canon=42, # page index H=2048, # page height crop_top=0, flipud=False, )

p: 하나의 stripe/board에 대한 전체 파이프라인: page 순회 → center 검출 → margin filter → dedupe → global mapping.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body: all_centers = subpx.process_stripe_board( files_v=index[(stripe, board)], stripe_meta={"Hprime": 100000}, board_meta={"x0": 5000}, cell_only_mask=cell_mask, # bool array, True for cell pages H=2048, reverse_pages=False, flipud=False, detect_kwargs=dict( area_min=5, area_max=200, refine="logquad", ), margin=5.0, dedupe_eps=1.5, ) # Returns (N, 2) float64 global [x, y] coordinates

p: 이미지 스택/시퀀스에 대한 일괄 처리 wrapper.

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
# 이미지 스택에 대해 일괄 center 검출 results = subpx.detect_centers_batch( image_stack, area_min=5, area_max=200, progress=True, # 50 frame마다 진행률 출력 )
# 대형 이미지 스택에 tiled 처리 results = subpx.detect_centers_tiled_batch( image_stack, tile_h=8192, area_min=5, area_max=200, progress=True, )
# 일괄 shift 추정 shifts = subpx.estimate_shift_batch( ref_frames, mov_frames, upsample_factor=20, progress=True, )

comp = subpx.connected_components_stats( binary_mask, backend="auto", connectivity=8, )
print(comp.num_labels) # number of components (excluding background) print(comp.labels.shape) # (H, W) label image print(comp.stats.shape) # (N, ...) per-component stats print(comp.centroids) # per-component centroids

h2: Workflow 1: Basic Center Detection + Pitch Estimation

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
import subpx import numpy as np
# 1. Load image image = ... # (H, W) grayscale
# 2. Detect centers result = subpx.detect_centers( image, area_min=5, area_max=200, refine="logquad", ) centers = result.centers_xy # (N, 2) [x, y]
# 3. Filter edge centers centers = subpx.filter_centers(centers, image.shape, margin=10)
# 4. Estimate pitch pitch_info = subpx.estimate_pitch(centers, k=8, refine=True) px = pitch_info["refined"]["pitch_x"] py = pitch_info["refined"]["pitch_y"] print(f"Pitch: x={px:.3f}, y={py:.3f} pixels")
# 5. Per-line pitch analysis pitch_lines = subpx.estimate_pitch_lines( centers, line_axis="row", tol=1.5, ) print(f"Median per-line pitch: {np.nanmedian(pitch_lines.values):.3f}")

# 1. Detect centers (assumed done) centers = result.centers_xy
# 2. Build and smooth distortion field field = subpx.fit_rowwise_distortion_field( centers, line_axis="row", line_threshold=10.0, bin_px=32.0, sigma_x_bins=3.0, sigma_row=1.5, )
# 3. Analyze periodic errors in residuals cloud = subpx.residuals_vs_x_by_line(centers, line_axis="row") spec = subpx.fft_pitch_error(cloud["x"], cloud["residual"])
# 4. Top periodic error components peaks = subpx.top_periodic_errors(spec, n=5) for i in range(len(peaks["frequency"])): print(f"Period: {peaks['period'][i]:.1f} px, " f"Amp: {peaks['amplitude'][i]:.4f} px")

# 1. Estimate shift between two images shift = subpx.estimate_shift(ref_image, mov_image, upsample_factor=20) print(f"Shift: dy={shift.shift_yx[0]:.3f}, dx={shift.shift_yx[1]:.3f}")
# 2. Apply shift to align aligned = subpx.apply_shift(mov_image, shift.shift_yx)
# 3. Crop to overlapping region ref_crop, mov_crop = subpx.crop_overlap(ref_image, mov_image, shift.shift_yx)
